6. Expedited Agenda (Announced on the evening of the Public Hearing)
Cases requesting an expedited public hearing will be heard at this time without an applicant
or staff presentation. Members of the public sign up to speak in opposition to a case listed
on the Expedited Agenda, then that case will be moved to the Public Hearing agenda, and a
full presentation will be provided, as listed below under Public Hearings.

8. Deferral/Continuation (Announced on the evening of the Public Hearing)
Action on cases requesting deferral/continuation will be taken prior to Public Hearings. If
the request for deferral/continuation is denied that case will be moved to the Public Hearing
Agenda, as listed below. The following items have been deferred to date certain of this
agenda or are continued from a previous agenda with the public hearings having been
closed.

10. Public Hearings To register to speak remotely on the following projects, please click HERE!
(Please Note: Signup for this meeting opens on Thursday, January 8, 2026, and closes
at 5:00 p.m. on Tuesday, January 13, 2026.) (In-person comments are still allowed.)

A. Special Use Permit #SUP2026-00001, Gainesville Crossing Firestone: This is a request
for a special use permit to allow a Motor Vehicle Service facility with 8 work bays and an
associated sign modification. The subject ±0.81-acre property is located southwest of the
intersection of Route 29 and University Boulevard and southeast of the intersection of
Route 29 and New Stable Way. The site is addressed as a portion of 7265 New Stable
Way, Gainesville, VA 20155, and is identified on the County’s Maps as GPIN: 7497-25-
7688 (part). The Property is currently zoned PBD, Planned Business District; subject to
proffers associated with #REZ2018-00008, Gainesville Crossing, approved by the Board
of County Supervisors on December 10, 2019; and designated COM-2, Commercial with a
transect two, in the County’s Comprehensive Plan. The property is located within the
Highway Corridor Overlay Districts, E-Commerce Overlay District, Airport Safety Overlay
District, and Gainesville 66/29 Special Planning Area. Gainesville Magisterial District.

B. Special Use Permit #SUP2025-00028, Gainesville Crossing Starbucks: This is a request
for a special use permit to allow a drive-through facility in association with a by-right
carry-out restaurant. The subject ±1.39-acre property is located approximately 400 feet
west of the intersection of Route 29 and University Boulevard. The site is addressed as a
portion of 7265 New Stable Way, Gainesville, VA 20155, and is identified on the County’s
Maps as GPIN: 7497-25-7688 (part). The property is Zoned PBD, Planned Business
District and designated COM-2, Commercial with a Transect 2, in the County’s
Comprehensive Plan. The property is located within the Highway Corridor Overlay
Districts, E-Commerce Overlay District, Airport Safety Overlay District, and Gainesville
66/29 Special Planning Area. Gainesville Magisterial District.
